notes: Ranges use training blocks 1-5 only; never changed after seeing test results.
Cheng temperature term exp[beta*(T-20)/T] uses degC; T<1 degC is evaluated as 1 degC (M3, M4).
2026-10-18 D-046: M2 a, b solved by bounded least squares for each candidate; bounds unchanged.
2026-10-18 D-047: final prediction of seeded methods = per-origin, per-lead median over the 5 seeds (finite outputs only).

2026-10-21 D-069: before the v3 formal runs, lower bounds of the N half-saturation constants widened to 0.01 mg/L (M1 Ksn, M2 KN, M4 KN; were 0.05/0.035/0.05) and M2 KP to 0.001 mg/L (was 0.0015), so that nutrient limitation can approach 1 (>= 0.9) at the median 2023 TN/TP of every waterbody (oligotrophic Lake Fuxian TN 0.14, TP 0.010 mg/L; Lake Erhai TN 0.27). Only widened, never narrowed (D-045). Checked on 2023 training data only.

2026-10-21 D-071 (audit A-01, A-07): T-PGNN restored to the original encoder-decoder layout (X_E: shortwave, precipitation; X_D: algal density, water temperature, TN, TP), Min-Max scaling, tuned set as the original (encoder/decoder layers, embedding dim, heads, feed-forward dim, two learning rates, weight decay, dropout, lambda), batch size fixed at 366. TPE budget stays 100 trials (D-017/D-037; original 200).

2026-10-21 D-072: T-PGNN batch size tuned in {16,32,64} instead of the original fixed 366. With ~350 training samples per waterbody, 366 gives one update per epoch (the original had ~6 per epoch with 2185 samples) and under-trained the model in the Lake Dianchi check (CV MAE 0.18/0.24 vs 0.11-0.16/0.19-0.23 with 16-64).

M2.ab_mode: least_squares (D-046): BO searches the 10 kinetic parameters; a, b solved in closed form within their bounds

M3.input_scaling: min-max of training blocks to [-1,1], no clipping

gp.kernel: constant mean + short smooth + quasi-periodic (Cheng 2025 App. C)
